messages:
sophie_cust: Hey — customer cust-128 says their embeddings changed width after we froze their model version. Previously vectors were length 1536, now responses are length 1408. Happened right after we applied the version freeze this morning.

maria_support: ugh. Do we have a sample request + response to repro? model name and the exact pinned version?

sophie_cust: model in question: `text-embed-redwood-lite` pinned -> `v3.2.0-freeze`. Sample API call below. Response shows `vector.length = 1408`.

sophie_cust: ```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "text-embed-redwood-lite",
  "input": ["search term example"],
  "user": "cust-128",
  "batch_size": 4
}
```

maria_support: thanks. can you paste the full `embeddings` response JSON (headers included if possible)? also any X-Model-Variant or X-Model-Hash headers from the gateway?

sophie_cust: response body: ```{ "data": [{ "embedding": [0.001, -0.002, ... /* 1408 floats */ ] }], "model": "text-embed-redwood-lite" }```

sophie_cust: headers: `X-Model-Variant: lite-quant-f14`, `X-Serving-Node: node-42`

jonah_ml: that variant header is suspicious — `lite-quant-f14` implies a quantized kernel path with 14-bit packing. v3.2.0-freeze should have shipped the 1536-dim float model, not a 1408-dim quant variant. Could be alias resolution to a different artifact ID after the freeze.

ryan_infra: @jonah_ml I'll check routing rules for cust-128. Sometimes reserved pins fall back to a variant alias when capacity is tight. Running query: `redwoodctl routing get --customer cust-128 --model text-embed-redwood-lite`

deploy-bot: Deployment event detected: `canary->freeze` for text-embed-redwood-lite @ 2026-03-16T08:12:03Z, artifact: `sha256:abc123...`, variant aliases updated: ["lite-quant-f14"]

jonah_ml: aha — the freeze step added an alias that points to a quantized variant with reshaped output. That explains the 1408 length. We need to revert alias for pinned customers or ensure pinned model resolves to exact artifact id instead of alias.

maria_support: next steps for support triage: 1) reproduce by calling pinned artifact id, 2) if mismatch confirmed, unalias or re-pin the exact artifact, 3) notify customer and offer remediation (reindexing guidance).

jonah_ml: repro steps I ran: `curl -H "X-Artifact-Id: sha256:abc123" ...` returned 1536-length embeddings. `curl` without artifact header returned 1408 with `X-Model-Variant: lite-quant-f14`. So aliasing is the culprit.

ryan_infra: I rolled back the alias for cust-128 routing and forced the pin to artifact `sha256:abc123`. Should be fixed now. Can you confirm with the customer?

sophie_cust: I'll ask them to re-run. Thanks. If they need reindexing we'll offer a migration window. :+1:

maria_support: escalating internally: CT-4287 created and assigned to jonah_ml. Notes: "alias->quant variant produced 1408-dim embeddings after model freeze; pinned artifact expected 1536; remediate by forcing artifact resolution for pinned customers and updating pinning docs." ETA: 2h for permanent fix.

jonah_ml: I'll follow up with a change to the pin-resolution path to prefer exact artifact id when a pin exists. Will post PR link when ready.

sophie_cust: customer confirmed vectors are back to 1536 after rollback. Closing loop with them now. Thanks everyone.
